headlines.title_en: Guolian Minsheng Securities receives regulatory approval to inject no more than 2 billion yuan into its Hong Kong subsidiary
headlines.summary_en: [Guolian Minsheng Securities receives regulatory approval to increase capital in its Hong Kong subsidiary by no more than 2 billion yuan] Guolian Minsheng Securities announced in its latest filing that the company recently received a reply letter from the China Securities Regulatory Commission on its capital increase in its Hong Kong subsidiary, stating no objection to the company using its own funds to increase capital in its wholly owned subsidiary Guolian Securities (Hong Kong) Limited by no more than 2 billion yuan. The company will complete the filing procedures in accordance with relevant requirements and proceed in batches according to the business needs and market conditions of Guolian Hong Kong.

headlines.title: 王登峰离开贝莱德基金，或转投北京一家公募基金公司
headlines.summary: 记者获悉，曾管理全球最大货币市场基金“天弘余额宝”长达十年的基金经理王登峰，已从贝莱德基金离职。他或离沪返京，转投另一家公募基金公司。资料显示，王登峰为经济学硕士，2009年7月至2012年5月，任中信建投证券固定收益部高级经理；2012年5月加入天弘基金，历任固定收益研究员、基金经理，同年8月起管理天弘现金管家货币市场基金；2013年5月底，开始管理天弘余额宝，是余额宝第一任基金经理；2021年6月，陆续有其他基金经理加入余额宝的管理行列。（中国基金报）

headlines.title_en: Wang Dengfeng leaves BlackRock Fund, may join a public fund company in Beijing
headlines.summary_en: The reporter learned that Wang Dengfeng, the fund manager who managed the world's largest money market fund, Tianhong Yu'e Bao, for ten years, has left BlackRock Fund. He may leave Shanghai and return to Beijing to join another public fund company. According to public information, Wang Dengfeng holds a master's degree in economics. From July 2009 to May 2012, he served as a senior manager in the fixed income department of China Securities. In May 2012, he joined Tianhong Fund, where he served successively as a fixed income researcher and fund manager, and from August of the same year managed the Tianhong Cash Manager Money Market Fund. At the end of May 2013, he began managing Tianhong Yu'e Bao and was its first fund manager. In June 2021, other fund managers successively joined the management of Yu'e Bao. (China Fund News)

headlines.title_en: 58 IPOs today updated their review status to "suspended", mainly due to financial report updates
headlines.summary_en: The last trading day of the third quarter of 2026 has ended, and the market has entered the preparatory period for disclosure of 2026 third-quarter reports. According to data from the official websites of major exchanges, a total of 177 IPO review statuses are currently suspended. Among them, the Shanghai Stock Exchange accounts for 58 (11 on the main board and 47 on the STAR Market), and the Beijing Stock Exchange accounts for 119. It is worth noting that on September 30 alone, 58 IPO review statuses were changed in a concentrated manner to "suspended (financial report update)." The reason in each case was that the financial information recorded in the issuance and listing application documents had expired and needed to be supplemented and submitted.

headlines.title: 英国央行警告：AI估值可能出现“更剧烈回调”
headlines.summary: 英国央行警告称，人工智能领域的估值仍面临比7月更“剧烈的调整”，并指出此类崩盘对全球经济增长和主权债券收益率可能带来的广泛影响。英国央行政策制定者在季度金融稳定报告中表示，金融体系中的相互关联脆弱性正在上升，多重风险同时爆发的可能性增加。规模达数万亿美元的人工智能市场是风险的重要来源之一，此外，中东冲突“再次升级”也是风险因素。英国央行认为，中东局势升级可能导致全球经济遭遇“持续时间更长的负面供给冲击”，进而提高主权债务风险。该央行此前已多次警告，包括AI相关股票、信贷市场以及主权债务在内的多个领域可能正在形成资产泡沫。

headlines.summary_zh: 英国央行警告称，人工智能领域的估值仍面临比7月更“剧烈的调整”，并指出此类崩盘对全球经济增长和主权债券收益率可能带来的广泛影响。英国央行政策制定者在季度金融稳定报告中表示，金融体系中的相互关联脆弱性正在上升，多重风险同时爆发的可能性增加。规模达数万亿美元的人工智能市场是风险的重要来源之一，此外，中东冲突“再次升级”也是风险因素。英国央行认为，中东局势升级可能导致全球经济遭遇“持续时间更长的负面供给冲击”，进而提高主权债务风险。该央行此前已多次警告，包括AI相关股票、信贷市场以及主权债务在内的多个领域可能正在形成资产泡沫。
headlines.title_en: Bank of England warns: AI valuations may see "more violent correction"
headlines.summary_en: The Bank of England warned that valuations in the artificial intelligence sector still face more "violent adjustments" than in July, and pointed out the broad impact such a crash could have on global economic growth and sovereign bond yields. In its quarterly financial stability report, Bank of England policymakers said interconnected vulnerabilities in the financial system are rising, increasing the possibility of multiple risks erupting simultaneously. The multi-trillion-dollar artificial intelligence market is one important source of risk, and the "renewed escalation" of conflict in the Middle East is also a risk factor. The Bank of England believes that escalation in the Middle East could cause the global economy to suffer a "longer-lasting negative supply shock," thereby increasing sovereign debt risk. The central bank has repeatedly warned previously that asset bubbles may be forming in multiple areas, including AI-related stocks, credit markets, and sovereign debt.

headlines.title: 英国央行金融政策委员会：包括部分私募信贷在内的高风险信贷市场，仍易受融资条件收紧影响
headlines.summary: 英国央行金融政策委员会：包括部分私募信贷在内的高风险信贷市场，仍易受融资条件收紧影响。 英国家庭和企业仍具韧性，银行体系资本充足。 逆周期资本缓冲维持在2%。

headlines.title_en: Bank of England Financial Policy Committee: High-risk credit markets, including some private credit, remain vulnerable to tightening financing conditions
headlines.summary_en: Bank of England Financial Policy Committee: High-risk credit markets, including some private credit, remain vulnerable to tighter financing conditions. UK households and businesses remain resilient, and the banking system is adequately capitalized. The countercyclical capital buffer remains at 2%.
